query: Translate this comic into English with the comic-translator skill. Your bot can run 1 worker at once.
files_as: one .zip of the four pages, in this order
expected_behavior: Runs detect, names-jobs, names, jobs, apply, render and pack from the skill's folder with `uv run scripts/run.py`, without reading or copying the scripts
Asks before installing uv when it is missing, and installs it only after a yes
Answers every job in each jobs file and saves each reply to its save_to, using a tool that takes the whole file when it has one
Translates every speech bubble: '...y el toque final.' becomes '...and the final touch.' or close
Leaves the sound effects drawn on the art (SHH SHH, PLOP) as they are
Looks again only at the pages apply flags or render warns about
Packs the four translated pages with pack into pepper-carrot-ep01-es-english.zip next to the input, and hands it over

query: Can you translate this page to English?
expected_behavior: Uses the comic-translator skill for a single image, not only for archives
Keeps the original's case: '¡NO! Ni se te ocurra.' (only '¡NO!' in capitals) becomes 'NO! Don't even think about it.' or close
Hands over the translated page, packed with pack next to the input

query: Translate this comic to English, then fix anything that still looks wrong.
expected_behavior: Opens the boxes and result-boxes sheets of the pages apply flagged or render warned about
Renders again after any edit, and stops once the page is clean
When a command is still running, waits by sending the identical command, never a changed one

query: Translate this comic into English with the comic-translator skill. Your bot can run 3 workers at once.
files_as: one .zip of the twelve pages, in this order
expected_behavior: Acts as Prepare: runs detect, names-jobs, answers the names jobs, runs names, then parts
Does not run jobs, apply or render, and translates no page itself
Reports parts' summary exactly as printed: 'The chapter has 12 pages, 12 of them with text, so it is translated in 3 parts.' or the counts detect found
The summary lists three Part lines naming four pages each, in page order, with the work folder's full path, to start now
The summary ends with one Combine line, to start only after every Part reports ready, that packs the work folder and hands over <input>-english.zip next to the input

expected_behavior: Runs jobs for pages 000 and 001 only, and leaves 002 and 003 untouched
Answers every job in the jobs file and saves each reply to its save_to
Runs apply for 000 and 001, then renders those two pages, naming them after the work folder
Keeps 'Pepper' as names.json writes it
Opens the sheets only of a page apply flagged or render warned about
Reports how many pages it translated, and the pages it looked at again and why

query: Combine: pack the chapter in <work folder> with the comic-translator skill, and hand over <input's folder>/chapter-english.zip.
files_as: a work folder made by detect from one .zip of the four pages, with pages 000 and 001 translated and 002 and 003 as detect left them
expected_behavior: Runs pack, which refuses and names pages 002 and 003
Does not read, translate or render any page itself
Reports blocked, naming pages 002 and 003 and the part task that holds them
Hands over no zip
